$schemaNote.purpose: Design-phase SÜLD visual asset registry (directive §20). It is separate from assets/registry/assets.json, which keeps the older lifecycle used by tools/validation/validate_registry.py and validate_resourcepack.py; nothing validates this file yet.

fields.type: weapon | armor | item | relic | ui | npc | mob | boss | vfx
fields.class: baatar | mergen | boo | darkhan | khulegchin | null
fields.tier: armour tier T1-T6, current class-weapon tier W1-W4, MobTier name, or null
fields.source: how the asset is made: procedural (repo generator script), gemini, meshy, blender, blockbench; '(planned)' when nothing exists yet
fields.concept: concept art / reference path, or null
fields.model: authoring source: generator script, .bbmodel, or Meshy reference (git-ignored)
fields.texture: texture path(s) in the resource pack
fields.minecraftAsset: the resource location the game uses (item model key, equipment asset id, font, skin key)
fields.triangleCount: for Java cuboid models: upper bound = elements x 12 (faces without a texture are not drawn). null for flat sprites, skins and unknown planned assets
fields.elements: cuboid element count of the in-game model (0 = flat sprite)
fields.fileSize: bytes on disk of all pack files for the asset (models + textures + frames); null when not built
fields.gameplayBinding: where SÜLD code/data uses it; null = not bound
fields.clientQa: NOT_TESTED | MANUAL_QA_REQUIRED (in pack, waiting for a real-client pass) | PASSED (date + tester)
fields.licence: own (made in this repo), or the third-party licence; absent on entries that predate the field

statuses.CONCEPT: specified (doc/brief or concept art); no production geometry or texture
statuses.PLACEHOLDER: a procedural stand-in shipped in resourcepack/ so code and the client can bind to the final resource location; not production art, to be replaced in place (same paths) by the real asset
statuses.GENERATED: Gemini/Meshy output exists for it (reference only, never shipped)
statuses.OPTIMIZED: processed into a game-ready model/texture (Blender bake, pixel texture, or procedural generator output) but not yet validated or not bound to gameplay
statuses.BLOCKBENCH_VALIDATED: Minecraft model passes bbmodel_validate / validate_resourcepack and budget checks
statuses.INTEGRATED: in resourcepack/ and bound to a SÜLD gameplay object (item def, Equippable assetId, mob, NPC, spell)
statuses.CLIENT_TESTED: checked in a real Minecraft 1.21.11 client against the QA checklist; date and tester recorded
statuses.PRODUCTION_READY: client-tested, within budget, history labels checked, approved by the owner

$schemaNote.honesty: No asset in this file is CLIENT_TESTED or PRODUCTION_READY as of 2026-10-07. File sizes, element counts and texture sizes of existing assets were measured from resourcepack/ on 2026-10-07.
